repos_data.description: Javascript SDK for trading on cryptocurrency exchanges like FTX, OKX, Bybit, and more. Supports API data feeds and WebSocket. Built by the Compendium Team.
AI crypto trading bot with deep neural network (84.9% accuracy, 25 coins). BiLSTM + Attention trained on GPU. Bybit, Binance, OKX, Gate.io. Free cloud or self-hosted.
